content:
{'text': '懷孕中的《Odyssey》女主角最近受訪時透露，醫生囑咐佢喺宣傳新片《Verity》期間唔好上YouTube大熱節目《Hot Ones》。', 'target': "The pregnant star of 'The Odyssey' recently revealed that her doctor ordered her to avoid appearing on the viral YouTube show 'Hot Ones' while promoting her new movie 'Verity.'"}

{'text': '該節目嘅玩法係名人一邊食越嚟越辣嘅雞翼，一邊回答主持人Sean Evans嘅深入提問，內容涉及佢哋嘅生活同事業。', 'target': "The show's premise has celebrities eating progressively spicier chicken wings while answering host Sean Evans' probing questions about their lives and careers."}

{'text': 'Hathaway喺上週末播出嘅播客《Talk Of The Townsends》片段中提到，喺《Verity》入面佢飾演嘅角色會上《Hot Ones》，佢喺片場食咗三隻真雞翼之後就要改用「道具雞翼」。', 'target': "Hathaway noted during a weekend episode of the 'Talk Of The Townsends' podcast that her character in 'Verity' appears on 'Hot Ones,' and she ate three actual wings on set before switching to 'prop wings.'"}

{'text': 'Hathaway話：「我本來諗住可以親身上陣做『Hot Ones』挑戰嚟配合呢套戲嘅宣傳工作，因為咁做最合理。但係我後來發現自己懷孕，醫生話我唔可以做，話可能會導致早產。」', 'target': '"I was actually going to do \'Hot Ones\' to promote this film because it made the most sense," Hathaway said. "But then I found out I was pregnant and the doctor said no because it could send me into early labor."'}

{'text': '聽到呢度，《The Devil Wears Prada》嘅女主角忍唔住笑到收唔到聲。', 'target': "The 'Devil Wears Prada' star couldn't help but burst into laughter at that."}

{'text': 'Hathaway補充話，希望明年有機會上Evans嘅節目，一邊狂灌奶昔一邊大爆粗口。', 'target': "Hathaway added that she's hoping to appear on the show next year and chug milkshakes while dropping F-bombs."}

{'text': 'Hathaway六月接受Access Hollywood訪問時提到，佢同丈夫Adam Shulman對佢喺43歲能夠成孕「完全無抱乜嘢期望」。', 'target': "Hathaway said during a June interview with Access Hollywood that she and her husband, Adam Shulman, had 'zero expectations' of her getting pregnant at age 43."}

{'text': '佢話：「我哋好開心，因為根據個人經歷，我哋清楚知道唔係人人都能夠如願以償。有時你想嘅時候未必能夠，有時甚至永遠都唔得。所以我哋視呢個為恩賜，絕對唔會當係理所當然。」', 'target': '"We\'re really happy because, you know, from our own personal experience, we know that it isn\'t always as easy as one might hope or assume," she said. "Sometimes it just doesn\'t happen the way you want it to, or when you want it to. And we just feel really, really grateful and we don\'t take it for granted, not even for a second."'}
